meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后,它会在你用编辑操作改完代码时检查其中的注释;如果发现有问题的注释,会停下来提醒你,先修复或解释那处注释,再继续后续工作。
howto.when: 在你用 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作成功改完代码后;若注释检查器发出警告,它会暂停并让你先处理被标记的注释。

say.text: 刚才被标记的注释有问题,先修好再继续
say.note: Claude 会先修复那处注释。

say.text: 先解释一下刚才那条注释为什么这么写
say.note: Claude 会解释写法意图后再继续。

say.text: 这个注释和代码对不上,帮我改一致

howto.what_en: After installation, whenever you finish editing code, it checks the comments in the changed files; if it finds a problem with a comment, it pauses to let you fix or explain that comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: It activates after edit-like actions such as apply_patch, write, or edit succeed. If the comment checker reports a warning, it pauses so you can handle the flagged comment before continuing.

say_en.text: Fix the comment that was just flagged, then continue.
say_en.note: Claude will fix that comment first.

say_en.text: Explain why the flagged comment is written this way.
say_en.note: Claude will explain its intent before continuing.

say_en.text: This comment doesn't match the code; make them consistent.
